description: This source file implements functions for logging and metrics collection related to Cuttlefish virtual machines, including building log events, determining OS type, and sending metrics requests.

classes.name: CuttlefishLogEvent
classes.description: A protobuf message class representing a log event in Cuttlefish metrics.

classes.name: MetricsEvent
classes.description: A protobuf message class representing a metrics event with various device and environment details.

classes.name: LogRequest
classes.description: A protobuf message class representing a log request containing multiple log events.

classes.name: Timestamp
classes.description: A protobuf message class representing a timestamp with seconds and nanoseconds.

classes.name: ClientInfo
classes.description: A protobuf message class containing client identification info.

classes.name: LogEvent
classes.description: A protobuf message class representing individual log events within a log request.

methods.name: ConvertMillisToTime
methods.description: Converts milliseconds to seconds and nanoseconds.

methods.name: BuildCfLogEvent
methods.description: Constructs a CuttlefishLogEvent protobuf message with device type and timestamp.

methods.name: GetOsType
methods.description: Determines the OS type based on system uname information.

methods.name: GetVmmManager
methods.description: Retrieves the virtual machine manager type from the configuration.

methods.name: AddCfMetricsEventToLog
methods.description: Populates a CuttlefishLogEvent with metrics data such as OS, VMM, and version info.

methods.name: BuildLogRequest
